data.one_liner: Detects browser page reload in Flutter web apps.
data.what_it_does: It listens for a browser refresh event and runs a callback. The callback can be used to reset state or navigate to a safe page.
use_when: You need to handle a full page refresh in a Flutter web app
You want to prevent crashes caused by lost navigation state
avoid_when: You already have a custom reload handler
weaknesses: No tests or changelog beyond initial release
